items.name: Juanita Hippocampus 2024
items.information:

This competition is **not recommended for first-timers** or for those looking for a typical competition experience. Please consider instead any of the other competitions happening in [Washington](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=washington&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list).

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc0JpIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--41c939ff9d04a9ee030bab08d4426f317f1ff9ec/image.png)

Το τρίτο μέρος της σειράς διαγωνισμών μας οδηγεί ξανά σε μια μοναδική τοποθεσία: τα escape rooms Rubicon! Εδώ, οι συμμετέχοντες θα αντιμετωπίσουν τα πιο περίεργα παζλ της σειράς. Μια απόλυτη δοκιμασία του μυαλού και της δημιουργικότητας, όπου η ευφυΐα και η επινοητικότητα θα είναι τα κλειδιά για την επιτυχία. Ετοιμαστείτε για έναν διαγωνισμό διαφορετικό από τους άλλους και ανακαλύψτε τις δυνατότητές σας σε έναν κόσμο γεμάτο παζλ!

Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. 

Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. 

[Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg)

[Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI)

The third part of the series of competitions takes us again to a unique location: the Rubicon escape rooms! Here, participants will face the most unusual and original puzzles. It's an ultimate test of the mind and creativity, where intelligence and inventiveness are the keys to success. Get ready for a competition unlike any other and discover your potential in a world filled with puzzles!

Please read the following tab very carefully to find all the necessary information.

Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs.
Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

CubingZA is excited to announce Deep South Solving 2024! This competition is mainly focused on the less popular events, from bigger NxNs like 5x5, 6x6 and 7x7, to side events like megaminx and clock, and even blind events!
Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, and make payment by buying a ticket. Please see Registration Requirements below.

We will include some fun prizes at this competition and there will be some interesting prizes to claim!

Competitors are welcome to bring 1 spectator with them. Please let us know if you need to accommodate more spectators.

Competitors can modify their registration through the Register tab.

1. Intent to change/cancel registration
2. Desired changes to registration
3. Name (and WCA ID, if applicable) of the competitor.

If registration fills up, we will place competitors on a waitlist. Welcome to TahimiKubing in MultiLupa 2024, the first speedcubing competition in Muntinlupa City! Rather than most standard competitions, this competition features **all Blindfolded events (3x3 Blindfolded, 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3 Multi-blind), Fewest Moves Challenge, and Clock**, with **3x3 Multi-blind** as the main event.

Considering the nature of these events, competitors and spectators are required to remain silent during ongoring rounds. **There also is no regular 3x3 in the competition**. If you are looking for a more typical competition experience, feel free to check out [other competitions happening in the Philippines.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Philippines&search=&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list)

We also highly discourage competitors from only registering for Clock.

**IMPORTANT NOTES:**
• Given the venue's size limitations, **competitors are strictly required to bring a maximum of one guest**. Please consider coming without a guest as the venue's accommodation size is limited.

• **If you are planning to attempt 10 or more cubes in 3x3 Multi-Blind, please contact the organizers ahead of time so that we can accommodate your attempt logistically.**

This competition is hosted by Cubers and Friends, a private organization of Filipino Cubers dedicated to crafting competitive experiences.

「東海チャレンジ2024」の全ての大会は、WCAの「ニューカマー月間2024」(WCA Newcomer Month 2024)の適用大会です。
詳細は、[WCA Newcomer Month](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokaiChallengeAlpha2024#40601-wca-newcomer-month) のタブをご覧ください。

### WCAシリーズ大会
「東海チャレンジ2024」はWCAシリーズ大会です。
WCAシリーズ大会は複数の大会を一連のシリーズとして扱うもので、それらのうち**一つにのみ**参加できます。
複数に申込んだ場合は、申込完了日時が最も早いものだけを受理し、その他は無効となります。

このページは「東海チャレンジ2024」の「ガンマ大会」のページです。
　・[Tokai Challenge Alpha 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokaiChallengeAlpha2024)(**本ページでは「アルファ大会」と表記**)
　・[Tokai Challenge Beta 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokaiChallengeBeta2024) (**本ページでは「ベータ大会」と表記**)
　・Tokai Challenge Gamma 2024(**本ページでは「ガンマ大会」と表記**)

各大会の種目、ラウンド数、開場時刻、定員は以下の通りです。
　・アルファ大会：3x3x3 のみ 1 ラウンド　開場時刻 9:00　定員40名
　・ベータ大会：3x3x3 のみ 1 ラウンド　開場時刻 13:00　定員40名
　・ガンマ大会：クロック のみ 2 ラウンド　開場時刻 16:00　定員20名

ガンマ大会終了後にTSCスペースを開催します。
　・スピードキューバーのためのオフ会です。
　・交流、親睦、情報交換を楽しんでください。
　・18:30開始、20:00終了を予定しています。

### 注意
注意１．来場時刻について
　アルファ大会については、時間厳守でお願いします。
　ベータ大会、ガンマ大会については、時間に余裕をもって会場にお越しください。
　競技の進行によっては前倒しで進めることがあります。

注意２．受付について
　受付はありません。
　必ず事前にご自身の役割（競技者、ジャッジ、スクランブラ）を確認してください。
　会場に到着しましたら、速やかに観客席に着席してください。

### 「東海チャレンジ」のコンセプト
「東海チャレンジ」では、できるだけ多くの方々にWCA大会にチャレンジしていただきたいと思っています。
アルファ大会、ベータ大会、ガンマ大会の違いについて簡単に説明します。

１．アルファ大会とベータ大会
　「東海チャレンジ」では、WCA大会初心者の方、WCA大会未経験の方に、WCA大会にチャレンジして頂きたいと思っています。
　アルファ大会とベータ大会は、3x3x3のみの1種目、1ラウンドです。
　ぜひWCA大会にチャレンジし、大会の雰囲気、大会の楽しさを味わってください。

２．ガンマ大会
　「東海チャレンジ」では、3x3x3以外の種目についてもチャレンジしていただきたいと思っています。
　ガンマ大会では、クロックを2ラウンドで開催します。
　クロックが好きな方、クロックに自信がある方、クロックで腕試ししたい方は、ぜひチャレンジしてください。

### 競技参加者以外の来場要件
**限られた会場広さで、できるだけ多くの競技者に参加できるようにしてもらうため、同伴者及び見学者に制限を設けております。**
　観客席に着席できない場合は、見学をお断りすることがあります。席を譲り合い、空いている席が無いように詰めてお掛けください。

### サポーター募集
より継続的かつ安定的にスピードキュービングチャレンジをするためには、大会を成立させるための運営側に人手が必要となります。そこで運営に興味のある競技者や、競技者の保護者の方に「サポーター」として活躍していただきたく思います。サポーターの役割は大会当日の会場設営、受付、呼び出し、記録入力・印刷、机消毒、撤収作業等になります。サポーターご自身の競技やお子さまの活躍の応援に影響の出ない範囲内でご協力していただきます。
後日サポーターの募集のご案内をさせていただきます。

### 主催団体TSCとは
東海スピードキュービングコミュニティ（以下 TSC）は、スピードキューバー向けのオフ会「TSCスペース」およびスピードキューバー向けの自己研鑽の場「TSCスペース自習室」をそれぞれ月1回を目標に開催しています。
また、SCJ大会を年4回を目標に、WCA大会を年1回を目標に開催しています。
現在、運営スタッフを募集中です。
一緒にWCA大会やTSCスペースを開催しましょう！

All the competitions in "Tokai Challenge 2024" are applied to the WCA Newcomer Month 2024.
For more information, please see the [WCA Newcomer Month](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokaiChallengeAlpha2024#40601-wca-newcomer-month) tab.

### WCA Series Competitions
Tokai Challenge 2024 is a WCA series competition.
WCA series Competitions are a series of multiple competitions, and you can participate in  **only one** of them.
If you apply for more than one series, only the one with the earliest application date will be valid, and the others will be invalid.

This page shows Tokai Challenge Gamma 2024.
　[Tokai Challenge Alpha 2024 ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokaiChallengeAlpha2024)(**In this page, called "Alpha "**)
　[Tokai Challenge Beta 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokaiChallengeBeta2024) (**In this page, called "Beta"**)
　Tokai Challenge Gamma 2024(**In this page, called "Gamma"**)

The events, number of rounds, opening time, and maximum number of players for each event are as follows:
　Alpha : 3x3x3 only, 1 round, open at 9:00, capacity 40
　Beta : 3x3x3 only, 1 round, open at 13:00, capacity 40
　Gamma : Clock only, 2 rounds, open at 16:00, capacity 20

TSC space will be held after the Gamma competition.
　This is an off-line meeting for speedcubers.
　Please enjoy socializing, friendship, and exchanging information.
　The event starts from 18:30 to 20:00.


### Cautions
Caution 1: About the time of arrival
　Please be on-time arrival for the Alpha.
　For Beta and Gamma, please arrive at the venue well in advance.
　Depending on the progress of the competition, it may be moved ahead of schedule.

Caution 2: Reception
　We have no reception desk.
　Please make sure to confirm your role (competitor, judge, scrambler) in advance.
　Upon arrival at the venue, please be seated at the spectator's seats as soon as possible.

### Concept of "Tokai Challenge"
In the "Tokai Challenge," we want to encourage as many people as possible to try out for the WCA competitions.
The following is a brief explanation of the differences between the Alpha, Beta, and Gamma.

1.Alpha and Beta 
　The Tokai Challenge is intended to challenge those who are new to WCA competitions and those who have no experience in WCA competitions.
　The Alpha and Beta are 3x3x3 only, one event, one round.
　We encourage you to try the WCA competitions and experience the atmosphere and the fun of the competitions.

2.Gamma 
　In the "Tokai Challenge," we would like to challenge you to compete in events other than 3x3x3.
　In the Gamma , Clock event will be held in two rounds.
　If you like Clock, are confident with Clock, or want to test your skills with Clock, please take the challenge.

### Requirements for non-competitors
**In order to allow as many competitors as possible to participate in the limited size of the venue, we have set restrictions on accompanying persons and visitors.**
If you are unable to be seated in the spectator seating area, we may refuse to allow you to observe.
Please be sure to share your seat and pack up and sit down so that there are no empty seats.

### Supporters Wanted
In order to make Speed Cubing Challenge more sustainable and stable, we need people to support the event. Therefore, we would like to ask competitors and parents of competitors who are interested in supporting the event to become "supporters". The role of a supporter on the day of the event will be to set up the venue, reception, call-outs, input and print records, disinfect the tables, and clean up. Supporters are asked to cooperate within the scope that does not affect their own competitions or their children's competitions.
We will inform you of how to apply for supporters at a later date.

### About TSC, the host organization
Tokai Speedcubing Community (hereinafter referred to as "TSC") holds "TSC Space," an off-line meeting for speedcubers, and "TSC Space Study Room," a place for self-improvement for speedcubers, aiming to hold each once a month.
We also aim to hold the SCJ competition four times a year and the WCA competition once a year.
We are currently looking for an administrative staff member.
Let's organize WCA competitions and TSC space together!

items.name: Graz Open 2024
items.information:
##### *English version is below*
​
#### **Deutsch:**
​
Speedcubing ist wieder zurück in Graz! Elf Jahre nach der letzten Competition freuen wir uns Graz Open 2024 als offizielles WCA Turnier anzukündigen.
​
Die Speedcubing Competition wird von Thomas Pucher, Fabian Staber und Felix Strasser organisiert sowie von Viktor Kalmar und Pranjal Khan delegiert. Die Competiton findet im Herzen von Graz am Campus Alte Technik der Technischen Universität Graz statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt.
​
Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können, den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden, solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen!
​
Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen.
​
​
Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich!
​
-----
​
#### **English:**
​
Speedcubing is back in Graz! Eleven years after the last competition, we are pleased to announce the Graz Open 2024 as an official WCA tournament.
​
The Speedcubing Competition is organized by Thomas Pucher, Fabian Staber and Felix Strasser and delegated by Viktor Kalmar and Pranjal Khan. The competition will take place in the heart of Graz at the Campus Alte Technik of the Graz University of Technology. The results of this competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings.
​
The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations.
​
Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.name: DFW Megacomp 2024
items.information:
This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024. The registration process will prioritize new competitors for registration, and returning competitors will be accepted after. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.

**New competitors registration will be accepted based on the following:**
* The first 25% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. 
* If greater than 25% of new competitors register, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors.
* If less than 25% of new competitors register before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

**Returning competitors may still register at any point during the registration period, but their registration will be accepted based on the following:**

* The first 25% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. 
* If 25% of spots are filled by new competitors, returning competitors will then be accepted on a first come, first serve basis.
* If 25% of spots are not filled by new competitors by registration close two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

---

As the month of March is WCA Newcomer Month, 25% of the competitor limit will be reserved for first-time competitors or competitors who's first competition is in 2024. More information can be found on the [WCA Newcomer Month tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWMegacomp2024#36408-wca-newcomer-month).

items.name: Athens Cubing Starter Pack 2024
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc0ppIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--7074cb88987f8a1665e68652fe09ce8f6b104f3b/image.png)

Ξεκινά η συναρπαστική σειρά των διαγωνισμών για το 2024 με το 'Athens Cubing Starter Pack 2024', τον πρώτο διαγωνισμό της χρονιάς, αφιερωμένο στους νέους λάτρεις του cubing! Με μεγάλη χαρά και ενθουσιασμό ανοίγουμε την αυλαία για μια σειρά από διαγωνισμούς, όπου νέοι συμμετέχοντες θα έχουν την ευκαιρία να αναδείξουν το ταλέντο και την αγάπη τους για το cubing. Το 'Athens Cubing Starter Pack 2024' θα είναι μια πρώτη ευκαιρία για τους νέους cubers να γευτούν την μαγεία του ανταγωνισμού και να γνωρίσουν την κοινότητα από κοντά. Μην χάσετε την ευκαιρία να γίνετε μέρος αυτής της μοναδικής εμπειρίας. 
Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε για την πρόκληση και ελάτε να γιορτάσουμε μαζί το πάθος για το cubing!

Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. 

Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. 

[Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg)

[Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI)

The exciting series of competitions for 2024 begins with the 'Athens Cubing Starter Pack 2024', the first competition of the year, dedicated to new "cubing enthusiasts"! With great joy and excitement, we open the curtain on a series of competitions where new participants will have the opportunity to showcase their talent and love for cubing. The 'Athens Cubing Starter Pack 2024' will be a first chance for them to taste the magic of competition and get to know the community up close. Don't miss the chance to be a part of this unique experience.
Grab your cubes, get ready for the challenge and come celebrate the passion for cubing together!

Please read the following tab very carefully to find all the necessary information.

Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs.
Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab.


----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1019092248614424637/1182038138156232814/WCA_Newcomer_Month_LOGO_A1_12.png?ex=65833dcd&is=6570c8cd&hm=8601e1d3b9f4839c2e67ef9936687a271a917d082791b5a0fbd068754df11b32&)

This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024. The registration process will reserve 25% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.

Registrations will be accepted based on the following:

* 25% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors.
* Initially, 75% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis.
* If greater than 25% of new competitors register before 75% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors.
* If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

**How to Change/Cancel Your Registration**

Competitors can change or cancel by emailing the organization team with the following information:
1. Intent to change/cancel registration
2. Desired changes to registration
3. Name (and WCA ID, if applicable) of the competitor.

Competitors can also modify their registration through the Register tab.

In the event that a competitor cancels their registration, they will only receive a 75% refund ($18.75 USD).

The deadline to change/cancel your registration is March 1st , 2024, 6:00 PM Mountain Time.

**Waitlist Procedure**

items.name: Beginner Cubing Delmenhorst 2024
items.information:
**English**

We are looking forward to welcome you at the first competition in Delmenhorst and the third one in Lower Saxony!

**This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024.** The registration process will reserve 35% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.

**Registrations will be accepted based on the following:**
* 35 spots (35% of spots) are initially reserved for new competitors.
* 65 spots (65% of spots) are initially available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis.
* If more than 35 new competitors register before 65 spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors.
* If the 35 spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

**Deutsch**

Wir freuen uns euch auf der ersten Competition in Delmenhorst und der dritten in Niedersachsen begrüßen zu dürfen!

**Dieser Wettbewerb ist Teil des offiziellen WCA Newcomer Month 2024.** Bei der Anmeldung werden 35% der Plätze für neue Teilnehmer reserviert. Als neue Teilnehmer gelten Teilnehmer ohne WCA-ID oder mit einer WCA-ID aus dem Jahr 2024. Wiederkehrende Teilnehmer haben eine WCA-ID, die aus dem Jahr 2023 oder früher stammt. Alle Teilnehmer müssen weiterhin alle Registrierungsanforderungen erfüllen, damit ihre Registrierung als vollständig gilt.

**Anmeldungen werden nach folgenden Kriterien angenommen:**
* 35 Plätze (35% der Plätze) sind zunächst für neue Teilnehmer reserviert.
* 65 Plätze (65% der Plätze) sind zunächst für wiederkehrende Teilnehmer nach dem Prinzip "Wer zuerst kommt, mahlt zuerst" verfügbar.
* Wenn sich mehr als 35 neue Teilnehmer anmelden, bevor die 65 Plätze von den wiederkehrenden Teilnehmern besetzt sind, werden alle weiteren neuen Teilnehmer nach dem Prinzip "Wer zuerst kommt, mahlt zuerst" zusammen mit den wiederkehrenden Teilnehmern zugelassen.
* Wenn die 35 für neue Teilnehmer reservierten Plätze zwei Wochen vor dem Wettbewerb nicht durch neue Teilnehmer besetzt sind, werden die verbleibenden Plätze bis zum Teilnehmerlimit den bereits registrierten wiederkehrenden Teilnehmern zugewiesen.

items.information:
###Português

O Schoolmark Open está de volta! Com algumas mudanças e surpresas, porém com a mesma atmosfera que tornou as primeiras edições tão boas!
Algumas informações importantes:
*  É imprescindível entender as regras, conforme **[Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)**
*  A competição é aberta a qualquer pessoa que deseje participar, indepentende de idade, nacionalidade, ou velocidade de resolução.
*  Além disso, a competição também é aberta a acompanhantes e espectadores.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

**Atenção**: Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem **certeza que irá participar.**
Em caso de desistência, por favor **entrar em contato com a organização ([felipeqcardim@gmail.com](mailto:felipeqcardim@gmail.com))**
As inscrições deverão ser pagas **via Stripe** na aba de **Inscrever.**


###English

Schoolmark Open is back! With a few changes and surprises, but with the same atmosphere that made the first editions so great!
Some important information:
* It's essential to understand the rules, as in the **[WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)**
* The competition is open to any person that wants to participate, independent of age, nationality, or solving speed.
* Besides that, the competition is also open to guests and spectators.

For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said in WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

**Attention**: This competition has a competitor limit. Sign up only if you are **sure you will attend**.
In case of withdrawal, please **contact the organization ([felipeqcardim@gmail.com](mailto:felipeqcardim@gmail.com)).**
Entries must be paid **through Stripe** in the **Register** tab.

items.name: Mid Summer Madness Cape Town 2024

venue.name: [Kirstenhof Primary School](https://goo.gl/maps/ibUsNtD2otafVyrp9)
venue.details: School hall and entrance hall for registration

items.information:
[CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce the first Cape Town competition for 2024. Dust off your cubes and get ready to set some PB's - or even records! Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, **and** make payment by buying a ticket. Please see **Registration Requirements** below.

### SPECTATORS

Competitors are welcome to bring 2-3 spectators with them. Please let us know if you need to accommodate more spectators.

### VOLUNTEERING

Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). 

### SPONSORSHIP
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbU10IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--03db2d12875f7b21e073b29649b48a5bc813b0e2/image.png)
A big thanks to [Speedcubes](https://www.speedcubes.co.za/) who are sponsoring vouchers as a part of the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to try out and buy the different speedcubes they have on offer.

### LUCKY DRAW

During prize-giving after 3x3 Finals on Sunday, we will be having a Lucky Draw for two winners to receive R250 Speedcubes.co.za vouchers each with free shipping on their order! If you needed another reason to stick around and watch 3x3 Finals other than the amazing speed of some of Africa's top speedcubers, maybe you could be one of the lucky winners and walk away with some free cubes or apparel courtesy of our local speedcubing store.

#### About CubingZA

CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. In 2024, we are anticipating being able to host one competition every season in each of the cities of Cape Town, Johannesburg, and Durban, as well as other regular events in Pretoria, Bloemfontein, Limpopo, and more!

If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to bring competitive speedcubing to the country, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact).

items.information:
##### *English version is below*

#### **Deutsch:**

Nach einem erfolgreichem Fasching Turnier im letzten Jahr, dürfen wir auch dieses Jahr wieder Vienna Fasching 2024 als offizelles WCA Turnier ankündigen.

Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von David Dinh, Jeremia Neuhold, Lucas Höglinger und delegiert von Viktor Kalmar und Pranjal Khan. Diesmal findet die Competition im Jugendgästehaus Brigittenau statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt.

Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen!

Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen.


Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich!

-----

#### **English:**

After a successful Fasching Competition last year, we are once again happy to announce Vienna Fasching 2024 as an official WCA Competition.

The speedcubing competition is organised by David Dinh, Jeremia Neuhold, Lucas Höglinger and delegated by Viktor Kalmar and Pranjal Khan. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings.

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations.

Every Competitor can bring one guest.

# ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaGxIIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e1a87d9563999f890af638f98836b63b2aac90c5/6u.png) Español 

Hay un límite de 40 competidores para el registro.

* Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes.
* Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución.
* **COMPETIDORES NUEVOS**: deben leer [Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AltavistaOpen2024#38590-importante-read) y [Competidores nuevos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AltavistaOpen2024#38591-competidores-nuevos-newcomers).
* Se debe tener en cuenta que los competidores pueden ser descalificados en los casos que prevé el Reglamento de la WCA. No se realizan reembolsos de ningún tipo por descalificación, según el artículo [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles.
* Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación de la categoría, de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del Reglamento de la WCA.
* Es importante leer toda la información disponible en la página de la competencia.

Ante cualquier duda consultar a los organizadores o a los delegados de la WCA.

***

* Competitors must bring their own puzzles.

A oferta dessa competição é para aproveitar o período de férias longe do stress e tumulto das praias e grandes centros urbanos, trazendo desafios em Gincana interativa, com atividades que desenvolvam o trabalho em equipes e a melhor interação entre os competidores, especialmente crianças do Sul do Brasil.

While most people travel to the beach during the summer, the idea of bringing the speedcubing community to a quiet and peaceful place in tthe Gaucho highlands gave birth to *Morro Reuter em Colônia 2024*!

The proposition of this competition is to take advantage of the holiday season, far from the stress and chaos of the beaches and great urban centres, bringing challenges in an interactive contest, with activities that develop teamwork and the best interaction among the competitors, especially the children from Southern Brazil.

See you there!

items.name: Barely Awake Boulder 2024
items.information:
We are excited to welcome competitors back to Boulder for the first time since 2016, and for the second ever 24+ hour competition held in North America!

Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. These tabs include important information regarding your responsibilities as a competitor and are very important!

This competition has a 150 competitor limit. Please try to limit your guests that you bring to the competition!
Competitions fill quickly, so it is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.

Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, this video will provide you with most of the information you need. https://youtu.be/dPL3eV-A0ww
If this is your first competition, please be present 15 minutes before the competitor tutorial at 11:00 AM, which means you should plan to arrive at 10:45 AM.

If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team, to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete. You will receive a 50 percent refund if you drop before the withdrawal deadline of (2024-01-20 00:00 UTC)

**How to Change/Cancel Your Registration**

Competitors can change or cancel by emailing the organization team with the following information:
1. Intent to change/cancel registration
2. Desired changes to registration
3. Name (and WCA ID, if applicable) of the competitor.

Competitors can also modify their registration through the Register tab.

In the event that a competitor cancels their registration, they will only receive a 75% refund ($18.75 USD).

The deadline to change/cancel your registration is December 23rd , 2023, 6:00 PM Mountain Time.

**Waitlist Procedure**

If registration fills up, we will place competitors on a waitlist. In the event a competitor drops from the competition, competitors will be accepted from the waitlist in the order we receive payment. Competitors can be accepted from the waitlist until December 23rd at 6:00 PM MST. You will receive a full refund if you are still on the waitlist by then.

items.information:
This is the 10th WCA competition in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
The competition is open to all persons from all countries.

**Note**: there is a maximum limit of ten competitors in the 3x3x3 multiblind event, on a first-come, first-served basis. If you register for multiblind after the ten slots have been filled you will be placed on a waiting list in case anybody deletes their registration later.

There will be certificates and medals for all competitors in top 3 of an event.

================

Ovo je 10. WCA takmičenje u Bosni i Hercegovini.
Takmičenje je otvoreno za sve osobe iz svih zemalja.

**Napomena**: može biti maksimalno deset takmičara u 3x3x3 multiblind disciplini, po principu „prvi dođe, prvi uslužen“. Ako se registruje za multiblind nakon što je deset mjesta popunjeno, bit ćete stavljeni na listu čekanja, i vraćeni sa iste u slučaju da neko kasnije izbriše svoju registraciju.

Za sve takmičare u prva 3 mjesta biće dodeljeni sertifikati i medalje.

# Bienvenidos al Mexican Championship 2023

¡Bienvenidos a la página oficial del **Mexican Championship 2023**, el campeonato de speedcubing más grande de México! Estamos emocionados de recibir a todos los competidores y entusiastas del speedcubing en este gran evento.


# Programa del Evento

El campeonato incluirá una serie de emocionantes competencias y actividades para participantes de todos los niveles. Desde los principiantes hasta los cuberos experimentados, habrá algo para todos. ¡Prepárate para desafiar tus habilidades y conocer a otros amantes del cubo!

# Reglas y Reglamentos

Asegúrate de revisar las reglas y reglamentos oficiales de la WCA antes del campeonato. Esto te ayudará a estar preparado y a asegurarte de que tus intentos sean válidos. Puedes encontrar las reglas en el [reglamento oficial de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/).

¡Que empiece la diversión y que gane el mejor!

# Welcome to the Mexican Championship 2023

Welcome to the official website of the Mexican Championship 2023, the largest speedcubing championship in Mexico! We are excited to welcome all competitors and speedcubing enthusiasts to this grand event.

# Event Schedule
The championship will feature a series of exciting competitions and activities for participants of all levels. From beginners to experienced cubers, there will be something for everyone. Get ready to challenge your skills and meet other cube lovers!

# Rules and Regulations
Make sure to review the official WCA rules and regulations before the championship. This will help you be prepared and ensure that your attempts are valid. You can find the rules in the official [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

Let the fun begin and may the best cuber win!

items.name: Greek Nationals 2023

venue.name: “Manos Loizos” Cultural Centre of Municipality of Nikaia-Renti

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdkpWIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d21635fc0f5cbe802272c9c1169d1a241d81b7bf/394771855_661572126079922_8082539372510634594_n.jpg)
Έφτασε επιτέλους η στιγμή που περίμενε τόσα χρόνια όλη η Ελληνική Speedcubing Κοινότητα! 
Το 2023 βάλαμε στόχο και πετύχαμε να απογειώσουμε το Cubing στην Ελλάδα! 
Και τώρα να ‘μαστε, μετά από τη σειρά των τεσσάρων "Road to Nationals" Opens μέσα στο 2023 σε τέσσερα διαφορετικά σημεία της χώρας, σε κλίμα γιορτινό και με όλες τις τιμές που πρέπει, να διοργανώνουμε τα πρώτα GREEK NATIONALS στο Speedcubing! 
Mε μεγάλη χαρά σας καλούμε, μικρούς και μεγάλους, Cubers και Θεατές στη γιορτή του Cubing, τη δική μας γιορτή, για να περάσουμε τρεις υπέροχες μέρες!

Παρακαλούμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες σχετικά με το εθνικό πρωτάθλημα του 2023. 

Σημαντική Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στη WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών Stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. 

Δείτε αυτά τα βίντεο για να είστε ετοιμασμένοι:

[Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg)

[Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων.](https://youtu.be/x5KaXXoh7XI)


The moment the entire Greek Speedcubing Community has been waiting for so many years has finally arrived!
In 2023 we set a goal and succeeded in boosting Cubing in Greece!
And now, after a series of four "Road to Nationals Opens" in four different locations of the country, in a festive atmosphere and with all due honors befitting the occasion, here we stand organizing the first GREEK NATIONAL CHAMPIONSHIP in Speedcubing!
It is with great pleasure that we invite you, young and old, Cubers and Spectators to the celebration of Cubing, to our celebration, to spend three beautiful days!

Please read through the following tabs to find all the necessary information about the 2023 Nationals

Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

# 🇺🇾
Límite de competidores: 40.

* Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes.
* Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución.
* **COMPETIDORES NUEVOS**: deben leer [Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoenLlamas2023#35967-importante-read) y [Competidores nuevos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoenLlamas2023#35968-competidores-nuevos-newcomers).
* Se debe tener en cuenta que los competidores pueden ser descalificados en los casos que prevé el Reglamento de la WCA. No se realizan reembolsos de ningún tipo por descalificación, según el artículo [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles.
* Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor descalificandolo de la ronda en cuestión, de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento.
* Es importante leer toda la información disponible en la página de la competencia.

Ante cualquier duda, consultar a los organizadores o a los delegados de la WCA.

# 🇬🇧
Competitor limit: 40.

* Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue.
* This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age.
* **NEW COMPETITORS**: You must read [Important](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoenLlamas2023#35967-importante-read) and [New competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoenLlamas2023#35968-competidores-nuevos-newcomers).
* Note that competitors may be disqualified under the circumstances described in the WCA Regulations. A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition, as per regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Competitors must bring their own puzzles.
* Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, as per regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations.
* It is important to read all the information available in the competition's website.

Feel free to contact the organizers or the WCA Delegates.

items.information:
**(Português) Brasileiro**
É com grande alegria que anunciamos o retorno do Capivara!

A partir desse ano, pretendemos trabalhar com doações para fins filantrópicos, assim, além de nos divertirmos, também ajudamos a fazer um mundo melhor. Estamos trabalhando em conjunto com o [LEO e Lions](https://www.lionsclubs.org/) para arrecadar brinquedos e alimentos para crianças carentes, então todo o lucro da competição será revertido para essa campanha. Além disso, se você quiser fazer uma doação no dia, também será muito bem-vinda.

Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição". Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=hfp2rKaN8jHPI_RL).

É muito importante que você conheça todo o regulamento, que podem ser lido [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/).

Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para as modalidades 'Feminino' e 'Iniciante', que tomarão como referência a classificação geral na modalidade '3x3x3'.

**English**
It is in great excitement that we announce the return of Capivara!

From this year on, we intend to work with donations for philanthropic purposes, therefore, in addition to having fun, we can also help make a better world. We are working together with [LEO and Lions](https://www.lionsclubs.org/) to collect toys and food to children in need, so all profit from the competition will be directed to that campaign. Besides that, if you would like to give a donation on the spot, it will also be very welcome.

Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements". If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://youtu.be/dZQiw5v8Bm0?si=6Yf5Zun_nlTfECTy).

It is very important that you know the regulations, which may be read [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards to the events 'Female' and 'Beginner', which will consider the final ranking in the '3x3x3' event.

items.information:
🇧🇷 Bem-vindos ao primeiro Salesiano Open, em Itajaí!

Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba Inscrever. Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste vídeo.https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8

Favor ler o Regulamento da WCA antes da competição.

Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para o feminino e para iniciantes na modalidade 'Cubo 3x3x3'.

A premiação das modalidades extra-oficiais será feita de acordo com a classificação do competidor na competição. (não será definida pela primeira rodada)

** Inscrições no local serão aceitas apenas para a modalidade 3x3.**

🇺🇸 Welcome to the first Salesiano Open, competition in Itajaí!

Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the Register tab. If you have any problem with how to register, take a look at this video.
https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8

Please read the WCA Regulations before the competition.

We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards for women and for beginners in the '3x3x3 Cube' event.

The unofficial events awards will be given according to the competitor's position in the competition (It will not be based on the first round results.)

** Registrations at the venue will only be accepted for the 3x3 event.**

items.name: GLS Final 2023
items.information:
Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło aż 54 turnieje w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju.

---

Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted 54 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

#### Warsaw Cube Masters powraca!

Zapraszamy do Warszawy zarówno starych wyjadaczy jak i nowych zawodników aby razem spędzić czas w atmosferze kostkowego święta. Poprzednia edycja zaowocowała rekordem świata w wykonaniu Macieja Czapiewskiego, mamy więc nadzieję, że i tym razem nie zabraknie znakomitych wyników i rekordów. Liczymy, że uda się nam spędzić miło czas zacieśniając stare przyjaźnie i zawiązując nowe.

Zachęcamy do przejrzenia wszystkich zakładek, znajdują się tam naprawdę przydatne informacje, a jeżeli nie wyczerpały one pytań, do kontaktu z nami za pomocą formularza dostępnego pod przyciskiem "Kontakt".

---

#### Warsaw Cube Masters returns!
We invite both old timers and new competitors to Warsaw to spend time in atmosphere of cubing festivity. Previous edition resulted in spectacular world record by Maciej Czapiewski so we hope that this time there will be a lot of great results and records as well. We also hope to nurture old cubing friendships and create some new while spending good time at the competition.

Please visit all tabs, you will be able to find there very useful informations, and if they will not answer all of your questions don't hesitate to contact us via form available under "Contact" button.

items.information:
NZ North Island Championship 2023 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

In addition, NZ North Island Championship 2023 is the last regional championship of 2023 in the lead up to Nationals in December.

items.name: Rubik's UK Championship 2023
items.information:
## Welcome to Rubik's UK Championship 2023!
### This year's UK National Championship!

#### Please read ALL tabs before registering as there is lots of information which will be new to you, even if you are an experienced competitor.

##### Spectators are welcome! Please read the information below, and the information in the [Guests, Spectators, and Media](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2023#32058-guests-spectators-and-media) tab.

**Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending Rubik's UK Championship 2023, you'll receive a Rubik's UK Championship 2023 t-shirt as a memento! **Please fill in your registration comment with your t-shirt size.**

**Guests:** Guests will **only** be permitted to attend by paying a **£5** fee **at the competition**. Competitors will receive lanyards, and their guests and spectators will receive wristbands, which are to be worn throughout the weekend for security reasons. **This includes parents/guardians of competitors.** The fee must be paid at the competition and cannot be prepaid beforehand. The guest field in the registration form is for informational purposes only; the fee must be paid at the competition. We accept cash or card payments.

**Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2023#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by *9th October 2023*, you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. There are no qualifications in 3x3, 2x2, Pyraminx, or Skewb, so **newcomers will be able to compete in these events only**.

**Final Round Advancements:** For all events with more than one round, we will be taking a minimum number of UK competitors to the final. If necessary, we will increase the size of the final by one competitor at a time until we have enough UK competitors. The requirements are as follows: 2x2, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1 - 6 UK competitors; 3x3 - 8 UK competitors. 3x3 Multiple Blindfolded has a Top 16 qualification requirement, similarly this must contain at least 6 UK competitors.

**Fewest Moves:** FMC will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at [Rubik's UK Championship FMC 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionshipFMC2023). The winner of the FMC competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Rubik's UK Championship 2023.

**Please Note:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete.

Hay un límite de 100 competidores para el registro.

* Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes.
* Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución.
* **COMPETIDORES NUEVOS**: deben leer [Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NacionalesUruguayas2023#29292-importante-read) y [Competidores nuevos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NacionalesUruguayas2023#29293-competidores-nuevos-newcomers).

* Se debe tener en cuenta que los competidores pueden ser descalificados en los casos que prevé el Reglamento de la WCA. No se realizan reembolsos de ningún tipo por descalificación, según el artículo [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles.
* Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la ronda, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento.
* Es importante leer toda la información disponible en la página de la competencia.

Ante cualquier duda consultar a los organizadores o a los delegados de la WCA.

***

* Note that competitors may be disqualified under the circumstances described in the WCA Regulations. A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition, as per regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Competitors must bring their own puzzles.
* Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations.

### (EN)

### Registration Reminders

Since this is a "favourites" competition, **you may choose at most four (4) events**. 

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations and registrations with more than four (4) events will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

### Mailing List

We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand for competitions in southern Ontario and are regularly planning and announcing more competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

### Competitor Requirements

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, you may want to look at the [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/files/WCA_Competition_Tutorial.pdf).

For new competitors, this video may help with competing. 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww&t=2s

Please see tabs for more information about the competition.

## Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

### (FR)

### Rappels concernant l'inscription

Comme il s'agit là d'une compétition de type " favoris ", **vous pouvez choisir au maximum quatre (4) épreuves**. 

Vous devez vous inscrire *et payer les frais d'inscription* avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées et les inscriptions comportant plus de quatre (4) épreuves ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails.


### Liste de diffusion

Nous travaillons fort pour répondre à la demande de compétitions dans le sud de l'Ontario et nous planifions et annonçons régulièrement de nouvelles compétitions. Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr)  sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou (https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions.

### Exigences pour les compétiteurs

Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les concurrents doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Si vous n'avez jamais participé à une compétition, vous pouvez consulter le [Tutoriel de la compétition de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/files/WCA_Competition_Tutorial.pdf).

Pour les nouveaux concurrents, cette vidéo peut les aider à participer à la compétition. 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww&t=2s

Veuillez consulter les onglets pour plus d'informations sur la compétition.

### Avis de droit à l'image

Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.name: Loutraki Open 2023
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaVpJIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4b69d3e8ec74c2e903cc944222c628b961b4e6ae/357003767_748136693777038_1928584195019389868_n.jpg)

To Loutraki Open 2023 είναι ο 4ος διαγωνισμός WCA στην Ελλάδα για το 2023.  
Ο διαγωνισμός γίνεται στις 16 και 17 Σεπτεμβρίου 2023 στην Κορινθία που είναι η γενέτειρα του Παναγιώτη Βερδέ, ιδρυτή και εφευρέτη των Ελληνικών κύβων [V-CUBE](https://www.v-cubes.com/) , που έχουν φτάσει σε 116 χώρες. Οι Ελληνικοί κύβοι [V-CUBE](https://www.v-cubes.com) ήταν αυτοί που από το 2008 επέκτειναν την σειρά των κύβων από το 5χ5.

Το Loutraki Open 2023 τελεί υπό την αιγίδα του WCA και διοργανώνεται από το ηλεκτρονικό κατάστημα [GamesUniverse.gr](https://gamesuniverse.gr/el/) , την [V-CUBE](https://www.v-cubes.com/) και την [V-Games](https://v-games.eu/) , όπου ανήκουν στην εταιρεία [Καινοτομίες Βερδέ ΑΕΒΕ](https://gamesuniverse.gr/el/content/8-poioi-eimaste).

Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε στο [Sport Camp](https://www.sportcamp.gr/el) στο Λουτράκι για μια μοναδική εμπειρία και γιορτή του cubing!
Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τόσο την παρούσα σελίδα όσο και τις επόμενες σελίδες  

Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA KAI να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. 

[Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RS768gK0Vrg&feature=youtu.be)

Σημείωση Αποδοχής κινηματογράφησης ή φωτογράφισης. 
Οι διαγωνιζόμενοι και οι συμμετέχοντες με την συμμετοχή τους στο Loutraki Open 2023 αυτόματα συμφωνούν με την πιθανή χρήση των εικόνων τους από τους διοργανωτές σε προωθητικές ενέργειες, κοινωνικά δίκτυα και άλλες ψηφιακές ενέργειες.

Οι online εγγραφές ανοίγουν στις 31.07.2023 και κλείνουν στις 11.09.2023.

Loutraki Open is the 4th WCA Competition in Greece during 2023. 
The competition is taking place on the 16th and 17th September 2023  at Korinthia prefecture which is the place of birth of Panagiotis Verdes, who is the founder and inventor of the Greek Cubes  [V-CUBE](https://www.v-cubes.com/)  that have reached 116 countries. The Greek Cubes  [V-CUBE](https://www.v-cubes.com) were the ones that since 2008 they have extended the cube line with cubes of more than 5 layers.

Loutraki Open 2023 is an official WCA competition and is co-organized from the e-shop [GamesUniverse.gr](https://gamesuniverse.gr/el/) ,  [V-CUBE](https://www.v-cubes.com/) and [V-Games](https://v-games.eu/) , that they all belong to [Verdes innovations S.A](https://gamesuniverse.gr/el/content/8-poioi-eimaste)  .

Grab your cubes, get ready, read the rules and come to [Sport Camp](https://www.sportcamp.gr/el) at Loutraki for an unforgettable experience and celebration of cubing!
Please read the following and the rest of the tabs very carefully.

Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site AND pay the registration fee as described in the next tabs.
Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

Notice of Acceptance for Filming or Photography
Competitors and other Attendees of Loutraki Open consent to their images being used by the organizers and its partners in marketing and promotional actions and materials, social media and other digital platforms.
 

Online registration open 31.07.2023 and close 11.09.2023.

東海スピードキュービングコミュニティ(以下 TSC)は、スピードキューバー向けのオフ会「TSCスペース」を定期的に開催しており、2023年9月に100回目の開催を迎えます。これを記念し、第100回TSCスペース記念大会を開催します。
今大会は受付時間を設けておりません。参加される競技に合わせてお越しください。競技の進行によっては時間を前倒しで進めますので余裕をもってお越しください。

Tokai Speedcubing Community (hereinafter referred to as TSC) has been holding off-line meetings for speedcubers called "TSC Space" on a regular basis and will celebrate its 100th meeting in September 2023. To commemorate this event, The 100th TSC Space Memorial competition will be held.
No check-in is required at the competition day. Please come according to the competition you will be participating in. Depending on the progress of the competition, it may be ahead of schedule, so please ensure to arrive in plenty of time.

The 100th TSC Space will be held after this competition. For more information, please visit [the 100th TSC Space Commemorative Website](https://100th.cubing.nagoya/).

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcFZGIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--fac9df56dfeac6acfe40bc84c7ad7f26f5fe6497/photo_2023-07-11%2021.26.31.jpeg)

**Русский**

Этот открытый международный чемпионат - первые официальные соревнования на территории Костанайской области. Базовый взнос с возможностью участия в любом количестве дисциплин составляет 3500 тенге, при регистрации на месте - 4000 тенге. При регистрации на 1 любую дисциплину регистрационный взнос составит 1000 тенге, на месте - 1500 тенге. Rudny Open - это первые соревнования, которые будут организованы командой QBERS.

**Қазақша**

Осы ашық халықаралық чемпионат - Қостанай облысындағы ең бірінші ресми жарыс. Пәндердің кез келген санына қатысу ақысы - 3500 теңге, өткізілу орынында тіркелген кезде - 4000 теңге. Кез келген бір пәнге қатысу ақысы - 1000 теңге, өткізілу орынында тіркелген кезде - 1500 теңге. Rudny Open - QBERS құрамасы ұйымдастыратын алғашқы жарыс.

**English**

This championship is the first-ever official competition in the Kostanay region. The base registration fee for any number of events is 3500 tenge. It's 4000 tenge when registering on the spot. If you're participating in 1 event only, the registration fee is 1000 tenge. It will be 1500 tenge when registering on the spot. Rudny Open is going to be the first competition organized by the QBERS team.

items.name: Tauranga Open 2023
items.information: Tauranga Open 2023 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcElrIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4be3c11536038145829dbcba17ca15bdea04981e/imagen.png)
# 🇺🇾
Límite de competidores: 40.

* Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes.
* Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución.
* **COMPETIDORES NUEVOS**: deben leer [Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoWinterOpen2023#31648-importante-read) y [Competidores nuevos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoWinterOpen2023#31649-competidores-nuevos-newcomers).
* Se debe tener en cuenta que los competidores pueden ser descalificados en los casos que prevé el Reglamento de la WCA. No se realizan reembolsos de ningún tipo por descalificación, según el artículo [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles.
* Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor descalificandolo de la ronda en cuestión, de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento.
* Es importante leer toda la información disponible en la página de la competencia.

Ante cualquier duda, consultar a los organizadores o a los delegados de la WCA.

# 🇬🇧
Competitor limit: 40.

* Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue.
* This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age.
* **NEW COMPETITORS**: You must read [Important](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoWinterOpen2023#31648-importante-read) and [New competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoWinterOpen2023#31649-competidores-nuevos-newcomers).
* Note that competitors may be disqualified under the circumstances described in the WCA Regulations. A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition, as per regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Competitors must bring their own puzzles.
* Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, as per regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations.
* It is important to read all the information available in the competition's website.

Feel free to contact the organizers or the WCA Delegates.

items.information:
[![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/)

## Appleby Summer 2023 Series

This competition is in a series with [Appleby Summer B 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ApplebySummerB2023). You will only be able to compete in *one* of these two competitions. Attempting to register for both of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.

## Registration Reminders

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted and registration fees will not be transferred across competitions. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

## Mailing List

We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand for competitions in southern Ontario and are regularly planning and announcing more competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

## No Food or Drink

Appleby College does **not** allow food or drink inside the gymnasium. Please consume any food or drink outside the gymnasium or off-site.

## Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

We hope to be able to put on a unique experience that will be enjoyable for everyone.

All competitors should read the Competitor Responsibilities and COVID-19 Safety tab before registering

There is no mask policy at the venue, but we still encourage anyone that wishes to wear one to do so. If the situation regarding COVID-19 worsens, masks may become a requirement closer to the competition.

**How to Change/Cancel Your Registration**

Competitors can change or cancel by emailing the organization team with the following information:
1. Intent to change/cancel registration
2. Desired changes to registration
3. Name (and WCA ID, if applicable) of the competitor.

Competitors can also perform some modifications to their registration through the Register tab.

In the event that a competitor cancels their registration, no refund will be offered due to the budget for this competition but we will give your spot to a different cuber eager to compete!

The deadline to cancel your registration is July 14th, 2023, 5:00 PM Mountain Time. The deadline to edit your registration is July 28th, 2023, 5:00 PM Mountain Time.


**Waitlist Procedure**

If registration fills up, we will place competitors on a waitlist. In the event a competitor drops from the competition, competitors will be accepted from the waitlist in the order we receive payment. Competitors can be accepted from the waitlist until July 14th, 2023, 5:00 PM Mountain Time. You will receive a full refund if you are still on the waitlist by then.

Välkomna till Gotland Open 2023, den första WCA-tävlingen på Gotland!
Tävlingen hålls på Gangvide Farm på Gotlands östkust ca 1 mil söder om Ljugarn. Gangvide farm är ett mysigt ställe där man kan äta färska ägg till frukost och ta ett dopp i ån!

Det blir en 2,5-dagarstävling med alla 17 WCA-grenar.

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information, speciellt fliken "resa".

Welcome to Gotland Open 2023, the first WCA competition on the island of Gotland!
The competition is held at Gangvide Farm on the east coast of Gotland about 10 km south of Ljugarn. Gangvide Farm is a cozy place where you can eat fresh eggs for breakfast and even take a swim in the river!
Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes.
It's a 2,5 day competition with all 17 WCA events.

Please read all the information tabs because they contain valuable information, especially the travel tab.
*If you are not competing in 4x4 BLD / 5x5 BLD you do not need to be present during Saturday.*

We're excited to welcome competitors back to northern Colorado Springs for another fun day of speedcubing!

Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. These tabs include important information regarding your responsibilities as a competitor and are very important!

* **Please read the travel tab before registering. Parking instructions are different than previous competitions at this venue!**
* **This competition has a 105 competitor limit.** Please try to limit your guests that you bring to the competition!
* Competitions fill quickly, so it is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition,[ this video ](https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww)will provide you with most of the information you need.
* If this is your first competition, please be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:15 AM.
* **If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team**, to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete. You will receive a 75 percent refund if you drop before the withdrawal deadline of Friday, July 7, 6:00 PM MDT. 

This competition is financially supported by Colorado Cubers!

items.name: Voula Summer Open 2023
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbUUvIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--25a11a161841639a3cff2ecfb046c27deb82697e/Cubestore_VSO23_post.jpg)

Το Voula Summer Open 2023 είναι ο 3oς WCA διαγωνισμός στην Ελλάδα για το 2023. Είμαστε περήφανοι για την πορεία μας φέτος και συνεχίζουμε δυναμικά. Στη σειρά διαγωνισμών "Road to Greek Nationals" εστιάζουμε σε κάθε διαγωνισμό σε 2 events που δεν είναι ακόμα πολύ γνωστά στην Ελλάδα. Σε αυτό το διαγωνισμό θέλουμε να φέρουμε στο ελληνικό κοινό τα αγωνίσματα του One Handed/Λύση με ένα χέρι και του Fewest Move Challenge (FMC)/Δοκιμασία λύσης με τις λιγότερες κινήσεις πιο κοντά στους συμμετέχοντες. Ο στόχος μας είναι να διεξαχθεί το πρώτο εθνικό πρωτάθλημα της Ελλάδας προς το τέλος του τρέχοντος έτους. Μέχρι τότε, όλα τα WCA events θα είναι οικεία στους συμμετέχοντες. Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε στην γιορτή του cubing!

Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. 

Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. 

[Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg)

The Voula Open 2023 is the third competition this year in Greece. We are proud of our progress and we strongly continue our effort. Grab your cubes, get ready, read the rules, and come to the cubing celebration!
During  each "Road to Greek finals" competition, we focus on 2 events that are not yet very well known in Greece. In this competition we are aiming to bring the events One Handed and Fewest Move Challenge (FMC) closer to the competitors. The goal is to make the first Greek National Championship towards the end of this year. By then, all WCA events will be familiar to the competitors.

Grab your cubes, study the regulations and attend the greek feast of cubing!

Please read the following tabs very carefully!

Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs.
Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

##### *English version is below*

#### **Deutsch:**

Wir freuen uns sehr euch Vienna Big Cube Summer 2023 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. 

Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von David Burany, Florian Truckenthanner, Felix Strasser, Lucas Höglinger, Jeremia Neuhold und delegiert von Bence Barát und Viktor Kalmar. Erneut findet das Turnier im großen Saal der Akkonplatz Pfarre statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt.

Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen!

Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen.


Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich!

-----

#### **English:**

We are happy to announce the Vienna Big Cube Summer 2023 as an official WCA Competition. 

The speedcubing competition is organised by David Burany, Florian Truckenthanner, Felix Strasser, Lucas Höglinger, Jeremia Neuhold and delegated by Bence Barát and Viktor Kalmar. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings.

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations.

Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.information:
## Southern Ontario Summer 2023 Series

We are running three competitions ([Newmarket](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SOSNewmarket2023), [Oshawa](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SOSOshawa2023), and [Waterloo](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SOSWaterloo2023)) as part of the Southern Ontario Summer 2023 Series. All three competitions are happening on the same day with nearly identical schedules. Please register for the competition that is nearest to you.

**Note: Newmarket has a competitor limit of just 60 competitors. Please plan accordingly by registering as soon as it opens or registering for Oshawa or Waterloo instead.**

You will only be able to compete in *one* of these three competitions. Attempting to register for more than one of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.

## Registration Reminder

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

## Mailing List

items.name: Stockholmsligan Final 2023
items.information:
Varmt välkomna till finaltävlingen i vårsäsongen av Stockholmsligan 2023! Mer information om Stockholmligans upplägg finns under fliken med samma namn. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information.

Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 18 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Notera dock att varje deltagare denna gång **får välja maximalt fem (5) grenar** att tävla i.

**OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen.

--

A warm welcome to final competition in the spring season of Stockholmsligan 2023! More information about the league's structure can be found under the tab with the same name. Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information.

The competition has a very special format, where each competitor has a total of 18 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. Note, however, that each competitor this time **can choose a maximum of five (5) events** to compete in.

**N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition.
